hotels.title: Grand Opening: Mission Beach Adults-Only Luxury with Daily A$100 Dining Credit, Breakfast & Direct Beach Access
hotels.description: Feel the gentle pull of the reef and rainforest as you sink into refined tropical bliss at Nala Resort on the shores of Mission Beach. This adults-only haven with direct beach access operates at a deliberate scale, designed with care in mind. From the lagoon-style pool to Nala’s personalised approach with pre-arrival concierge, every moment is set to a relaxed pace and curated for mindful, effortless rest. Exceptional dining completes the experience; refined coastal Australian selections, tropical breakfast and a nightly dining credit to shape dinner as you choose. Golden hour is marked with a complimentary glass of sparkling each night before a first-class dinner of wagyu striploin, coral trout or house-made ricotta gnocchi, followed by sensational desserts and artisan cheeses. When you’re not dining or laying by the pool, venture out into the local rainforest for a daily dose of vitamin green. And to further enhance your relaxation, in-room massages with private breathwork, yoga and meditation sessions are available by request at an additional cost.
